description: SAM3 text-driven image segmentation/matting: upload an image and describe the target object (e.g. 'the red car', 'a person with a hat') to produce its mask. No manual box-clicking.

best_for: text-driven image segmentation / matting (describe the object to mask)
background removal / cutout from a single image
selection_guidance.agent_hint: Prefer this when the user wants to isolate/mask/cut out an object in an image by describing it in words. The prompt names the object to segment (e.g. 'the cat', 'a person'). Requires --image and -p "object description".
